item.text:
Implemented the Rust port as a complete Cargo project in `/output`, with the entry file at [test10.rs](/output/test10.rs) and module-organized code in [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs), [src/cli.rs](/output/src/cli.rs), [src/geometry.rs](/output/src/geometry.rs), [src/earcut.rs](/output/src/earcut.rs), and [src/output.rs](/output/src/output.rs). The CLI uses `std::env::args()` and matches the observed `std::atoi` behavior from the C++ binary.

It compiles successfully both ways: `cargo build --release` and `rustc --edition=2021 test10.rs -o test10`. Executables are available at `/output/test10` and `/output/target/release/test10`. I verified byte-for-byte matching output against `/workspace/dataset/test10_executable` for the default invocation and for `0`, `1`, `+2x`, and `abc`.
